title: AD Security Dashboard (Lab)
author: Ajit Nayak
description: Real-time SIEM view of Active Directory security events. Triage Kerberoasting, DCSync, and Privilege Escalation indicators using threat intelligence and risk scoring

panels.title: Event Frequency Over Time
panels.description: Heatmap of AD security events by hour and event type

panels.title: Recent High-Risk Accounts
